summary: Frontend E2E of Finance > Fixed Assets tab (iter370 features) on 58:12 Uganda. Verified currency (UGX everywhere), add-with/without-expense, campus + paid-from + expense-account selects, log-spend Repair/Improvement, edit (name/value/condition), merge (sums values, moves spend history), and delete (persists after reload). Register left empty as required.

design_issues.screen: Finance > Fixed Assets — Add asset dialog / Log spend dialog
issues: When 'Also record this as an expense' is toggled ON, the default Expense-account fallback on this campus resolves to 'Salaries & Wages DNU' (visible in Finance > Overview > Recent activity for the TEST_ entries). This is a COA/data configuration issue in the tenant, not a code bug, but it makes the default posting look wrong. Consider defaulting the expense account for asset purchases to 'Fixed Asset Purchases' (or similar) when the user leaves the picker on 'Default expenses account'. AssetsRegister.jsx:46-53

action_items: Optional: in routers/finance/assets.py _post_expense(), when the caller omits expense_account_id, prefer a dedicated 'Fixed Asset Purchases' / 'Repairs & Maintenance' account instead of the first expense account found (currently posts to 'Salaries & Wages DNU' on 58:12 Uganda).
Optional UX: purchase-cost label in Add-asset dialog updates when Currency changes only because the input's Label reads assetForm.currency — good. Same for spend dialog. No action, just noted.
critical_code_review_comments: AssetsRegister.jsx:129 — toast text for post_expense on create relies on r.data?.purchase_expense_id but toasts sometimes stack; not a bug, just noisy for automation.
AssetsRegister.jsx:162-164 — improvement/repair toasts are correct but overlap during quick sequences; consider dismissing previous toast on new op.

AssetsRegister.jsx:138 — PUT body currently spreads editForm including any residual keys; harmless because backend response confirmed only known fields returned, but consider explicitly whitelisting fields.
File length 618 lines is at the upper edge of the 700-line guideline — future work: extract ExpenseOption and the dialogs into siblings.

Only cosmetic concern: default expense-account fallback resolves to 'Salaries & Wages DNU' on this campus — tenant COA config, not code.
